existing_candidates.texture: Native TXD/index/CLUT/mask owner; adding glyph drawing would mix artwork and storage. Keep unchanged.
existing_candidates.generatePalette: Pure numerical normalization/median/Lloyd; cannot reasonably own spatial composition. Keep unchanged.
existing_candidates.glyphMaps/previewFit: Native encoded-word aliases and consumer measurements, not RGBA rendering. Keep unchanged.
existing_candidates.authorTexture: Sole production texture caller (run45); enhance profile/font loading and orchestration, retaining PNG/decode/import/pins/publisher. Inlining drawing/outline loops would mix pure raster creation with I/O.
existing_candidates.tests: Enhance existing TestCLIDryRunAndApply standalone authoring block; no new test function/closure.

unavoidable_function: ONE pure composeCells owner validates binary glyph masks, lays out centered words and composes outlined/shaded replacement cells. No reasonable existing owner for pixel creation; no per-label handler/helper family/dependency/writer.
minimal_interface: Existing TextureProfile gains optional inline render recipe, mutually exclusive with PNG/rectangles/palette generation. A texture profile already is a separate purpose-grouped recipe file, so avoid another wrapper render-file input. Render references a pinned shared font JSON; font references pinned grayscale PNG. Existing PNG loader is shared for candidate/font input. composeCells returns candidate and derived cell rectangles; cell geometry is the single approved mask owner.
data_ownership: Five approved historical cell IDs/words/colors/rectangles in one texture profile, not Go literals; no guessed registry IDs. Font metrics/mask in shared fonts/ descriptor+PNG. Legacy scripts remain behavioral references, no retirement from prototype.
preservation: Existing PNG/export/default/exact/quantize/RGBA callers unchanged. Render feeds same calibrated texture parser/import, mask check and exclusive artifact writer. No original/shipping/custom-art/registry/ISO writes or emulator access.
